The observed binding of Cyp2c19 to Formoterol and Cilostazol, which are both linked to Torasemide, indicates that Cyp2c19 is a target of multiple drugs, including those that may interact with it through similar mechanisms. The integration of these pathways suggests that Torasemide may influence Cyp2c19 activity, potentially through a mechanism involving the inhibition of Cyp2c19 or other related enzymes.
